issues.fix: 11_exterior.js l.445: replace the normal-only bake with a normal plus height bake, so the flank grades down to the keel whichever side the sun is on: `shadeVerts(B, vC, vN, (p, n) => { const dy = wingAt(Math.abs(p[0]), p[2] - WING.dz, side, -1)[1] - p[1]; return (n[1] > 0.45 ? 1 : 0.5 + 0.4 * smooth(-0.9, -0.2, n[1])) * lerp(1, 0.66, smooth(0.06, 0.65, dy)); })`. The crown facet (n.y > 0.45) stays at 1, the upper flank is about 0.9 and the lower flank about 0.6. In w26K that gives roughly crown 215 / mid-flank 160 / lower 120, close to _7250. The A side would drop back to about 0.55. Compensate there with lighting: lighting owner, raise u_extBounce on exterior normals with |n.y| < 0.35 by about 1.25x. Do not raise the floor again. For the tail shape at l.351, taper the width to the same end as the depth: `lerp(1, 0.09, Math.pow(tail(xn), 0.9))` for rw. At l.353 use `sec(x1 + u*RE, 0.09*e, 0.09*e)` so the point is a wedge, not a spoon. At l.345, sharpen the chine: r = Math.min(w*0.18, d*0.2).
